desc: The DT-PR Stock is the Precision Rifle (PR) variant in the DT series of carbine stocks. It features a bag rider that anchors the rifle on squeeze bags for precise shots, while remaining entirely functional as an on-the-move tactical platform. The DT-PR stock is a lightweight carbine stock built around the patent-pending Dual Tension (DT) cartridge which removes any variance between buffer tubes and the stock, resulting in a tighter fit across the stock's LOP. It also doesn't pull facial hair when a shooter's face makes contact with the stock. The entire DT line of stocks are compatible with Magpul's legacy MOE/CTR cheek risers, giving shooters the ability to adjust comb height for improved efficiency in target acquisition. The DT-PR features a contoured butt-pad so shooters have improved shoulder contact. The stock also includes ambidextrous rotation-limited Quick Disconnect (QD) sling cups and a footman's loop for various sling configurations.
